ex.en: The street is dark after eight.
ex.zh: 八点以后这条街很黑。

ex.en: A dark walk from the bus stop to the school gate is a safety problem, not a small inconvenience.
ex.zh: 从车站走到校门的一段黑路是安全问题，不是小不便。

tip: dark 也可作名词，前面常加 the。

senses.en: numbers that give information, or the study of them

ex.en: The statistics show who uses the late bus.
ex.zh: 统计数字显示谁在坐晚班车。

ex.en: Statistics without a source are just another opinion.
ex.zh: 没有来源的统计数字只是另一种意见。

tip: 作“统计学”时谓语常用单数。作“统计数字”时谓语用复数。

senses.en: ground, or the solid part of the earth
to come down onto the ground

ex.en: The school sits on flat land near the river.
ex.zh: 学校坐落在河边的平地上。

ex.en: Cheap land beside a river looks useful until the first flood shows why it was empty.
ex.zh: 河边的廉价土地看起来有用，直到第一次洪水说明它为什么曾经空着。

tip: land 作动词是“着陆”或“登陆”。

senses.en: the keeping of things until they are needed

ex.en: There is no storage for the extra chairs.
ex.zh: 没有地方存放多余的椅子。

ex.en: Cold storage for milk matters more than a new sign on the canteen door.
ex.zh: 牛奶的冷藏比食堂门上的新牌子更重要。

tip: storage 通常不可数。store 已在本库。

ex.en: Measure the length of the table first.
ex.zh: 先量桌子的长度。

ex.en: The length of a school day changes how much daylight children still have for sport.
ex.zh: 上课日的长度会改变孩子放学后还剩多少日光可以运动。

tip: 长度用 length。at length 是书面语，表示详尽地。

ex.en: I am glad to see you back at school.
ex.zh: 看到你回学校我很高兴。

ex.en: Parents are glad when a late bus is explained, even if the delay itself cannot be avoided.
ex.zh: 即使晚点本身无法避免，只要有人解释，家长也会高兴一些。

tip: glad 作表语，一般不说 a glad person。

ex.en: The supreme rule here is to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 这里的最高规定是锁好实验室。

ex.en: A supreme court decision can change what a textbook is allowed to say.
ex.zh: 最高法院的裁决可以改变课本被允许写的内容。

tip: supreme 程度已经最高，一般不再加 most。

ex.en: Rain is likely today.
ex.zh: 今天可能下雨。

ex.en: Do not swim where the river is deep.
ex.zh: 河水深的地方不要游泳。

ex.en: Deep floods reach streets that a shallow rain never touches.
ex.zh: 深的洪水会漫到浅雨从不到达的街道。

tip: deep 可形容水、颜色、睡眠或感情。

ex.en: Please come to the office immediately.
ex.zh: 请立刻到办公室来。

ex.en: A leaking gas pipe should be reported immediately, not after the next lesson.
ex.zh: 煤气管道泄漏应该立刻报告，而不是等下一节课之后。

tip: immediately 是副词；immediate 是形容词。

ex.en: The kid by the gate is waiting for his sister.
ex.zh: 门口的小孩在等他姐姐。

ex.en: A kid walking home in the dark needs a light on the street, not only a lecture about safety.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中走回家的小孩需要街上的灯，而不只是关于安全的说教。

tip: kid 是口语。正式写作多用 child。

senses.en: an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: Success needs continuous effort.
ex.zh: 成功需要持续努力。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
ex.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

ex.en: The goods arrived before the shop opened.
ex.zh: 货物在商店开门前到了。

ex.en: Goods left in the rain outside a school shop are nobody's bargain.
ex.zh: 放在学校小卖部外淋雨的货物，谁买了都不划算。

tip: goods 是复数，不说 a goods。表里这一行的音标是 good，本库不用。

ex.en: The meeting will start soon.
ex.zh: 会议很快就要开始。

ex.en: A leaking roof will soon damage books if a school waits for a perfect budget.
ex.zh: 如果学校一直等一份完美的预算，漏雨的屋顶很快会损坏书籍。

tip: as soon as 引导时间从句，主句将来时，从句用一般现在时。

senses.en: a piece of a whole, or a role

ex.en: This chapter is the hardest part of the book.
ex.zh: 这一章是书里最难的部分。

ex.en: Parents are only one part of a child's education; streets, screens, and friends shape habits too.
ex.zh: 父母只是孩子教育的一部分；街道、屏幕和朋友也会塑造习惯。

tip: take part in 表示参加活动，不要漏掉 in。

ex.en: Do not waste paper on a second cover.
ex.zh: 不要为了再做一个封面浪费纸。

ex.en: Food waste from the canteen can feed a garden if someone sorts it the same day.
ex.zh: 如果有人当天分类，食堂的食物废料可以供给花园。

tip: waste 作名词是废物或浪费。food waste 里 waste 可以是名词。

senses.en: the leader of a country, club, or some universities

ex.en: The club president will speak first.
ex.zh: 社团主席将首先发言。

ex.en: A student president who only repeats teachers ideas will not represent the class.
ex.zh: 只重复老师想法的学生主席，代表不了班级。

tip: president 在不同机构里可以是总统、主席或大学校长。

senses.en: a person's own nature or identity

ex.en: The exercise asks you to describe your self in three words.
ex.zh: 这个练习请你用三个词描述自己。

ex.en: A sense of self grows when students are trusted with real tasks, not only with tests.
ex.zh: 当学生被托付真正的任务而不只是考试时，自我意识会成长。

tip: self 常构成复合词，如 self-study。复数是 selves。

senses.en: on all sides of, or about

ex.en: We walked around the lake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们绕着湖走了走。

ex.en: Shops around a school gate affect what students buy between classes, from water to sweets.
ex.zh: 校门口的商店影响着学生课间买什么，从水到糖果都是。

tip: around 表示大约时与 about 接近：around 20 students。

senses.en: a female ruler, or the wife of a king

ex.en: The queen visited the old harbour in the story.
ex.zh: 故事里女王参观了古老的港口。

ex.en: A history chapter about a queen should also say who cooked, farmed and paid the taxes.
ex.zh: 写女王的历史章节，也应当说谁在做饭、种地和纳税。

tip: queen 可以是女性君主，也可以是国王的妻子。

senses.en: work, especially physical work; British spelling

ex.en: Harvest labour starts before sunrise.
ex.zh: 收割的劳动在日出前就开始了。

ex.en: Child labour is illegal, and a weekend school job is not the same thing.
ex.zh: 童工是非法的，周末在学校打工不是一回事。

tip: labour 是英式拼写，labor 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

ex.en: The staff were friendly to the new students.
ex.zh: 工作人员对新同学很友好。

ex.en: A friendly match still needs a referee and a way home.
ex.zh: 友谊赛仍然需要裁判和回家的办法。

tip: friendly 是形容词，不是副词。友好地用 in a friendly way。friend 已在本库。

senses.en: measuring a lot from side to side

ex.en: The new pavement is wide enough for two people.
ex.zh: 新的人行道宽得够两个人走。

ex.en: A wide road without a crossing is still a barrier for a child.
ex.zh: 没有过街处的宽路，对孩子仍然是障碍。

tip: wide 强调横向的宽；broad 常强调幅面或抽象的广。

ex.en: Strong belief can give people hope.
ex.zh: 坚定的信念能给人希望。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

ex.en: Birds fly over the sports field.
ex.zh: 鸟飞过运动场。

ex.en: A town that wants fewer cars cannot only tell people to fly; most journeys are short.
ex.zh: 想减少汽车的城镇不能只叫人坐飞机，大多数行程都很短。

tip: fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown。航班名词 flight 已在本库。

ex.en: Please stay in the waiting room until your name is called.
ex.zh: 请在候诊室等到叫你的名字。

ex.en: A crowded waiting room shows that a clinic needs more staff, not only more chairs.
ex.zh: 拥挤的候诊室说明诊所需要更多工作人员，而不只是更多椅子。

col: in the waiting room｜在等候室
tip: waiting room 中间有空格。医院、车站都可以用。

senses.en: low temperature, or a common illness

ex.en: It is cold in the classroom this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨教室里很冷。

ex.en: Cold classrooms in winter make it harder to learn, especially for children who walked a long way.
ex.zh: 冬天寒冷的教室让学习更难，尤其是走了很远路的孩子。

tip: cold 作名词是“寒冷”或“感冒”。

senses.en: a path, a rail, or marks left behind

ex.en: She runs on the track after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后在跑道上跑。

ex.en: Keeping track of bus delays shows which routes fail students most often.
ex.zh: 记录公交延误，能显示哪些线路最常让学生失望。

tip: track 作动词是“跟踪”。

ex.en: The northern wind made the field feel colder.
ex.zh: 北风让田野感觉更冷。

ex.en: Northern towns may need longer heating, which changes the winter school budget.
ex.zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖，这会改变冬季的学校预算。

tip: northern 是形容词。名词“北方”用 north。

senses.en: a person who does not like change

ex.en: The plan is conservative and keeps the old bus.
ex.zh: 这个方案很保守，保留了旧公交。

ex.en: A conservative estimate of the cost is safer than a hopeful one.
ex.zh: 对费用的保守估计，比乐观的估计更安全。

tip: conservative 也可作名词“保守的人”。政治里的 Conservative 常大写。

ex.en: We will walk unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，否则我们走路去。

ex.en: A river will not recover unless the factories upstream stop the night waste.
ex.zh: 除非上游工厂停止夜间排污，否则河不会恢复。

tip: unless 等于 if not，本身已含否定，从句里一般不再加 not。

senses.en: to make something, or to show it
food that is grown, especially in large amounts

ex.en: The factory produces parts for buses.
ex.zh: 这家工厂生产公交零件。

ex.en: Local farms that produce food for the school can shorten the road from field to canteen.
ex.zh: 为学校生产食物的本地农场，可以缩短从田地到食堂的路。

tip: 动词重音在后。名词 produce 指农产品，重音在前。

senses.en: material burned to produce heat or power

ex.en: The bus runs on cleaner fuel this year.
ex.zh: 今年这辆公交使用更清洁的燃料。

ex.en: Cutting fuel use in old buildings can pay for itself if the windows actually close.
ex.zh: 如果窗户真的能关上，减少旧楼的燃料消耗可以收回成本。

tip: fuel 作物质名词时常不可数。作动词是加燃料或激起。

senses.en: to keep in the hand, to organise, or to contain

ex.en: Please hold the door for the next person.
ex.zh: 请为后面的人扶住门。

ex.en: A hall that cannot hold the whole school should not be the only place for a fire drill.
ex.zh: 容纳不下全校的礼堂，不该是消防演习的唯一地点。

tip: hold 的过去式和过去分词是 held。

senses.en: a hot drink made from coffee beans

ex.en: The teachers drink coffee in the office.
ex.zh: 老师们在办公室喝咖啡。

ex.en: A night of coffee before an exam keeps students awake, and it also makes the next morning harder.
ex.zh: 考前一夜咖啡能让学生醒着，也会让第二天早上更难熬。

col: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡
tip: coffee 作物质名词不可数。a coffee 可以指一杯咖啡。

ex.en: She is learning a foreign language.
ex.zh: 她在学一门外语。

ex.en: Foreign news is useful only when students also know how to check the source.
ex.zh: 只有当学生也知道如何核对来源时，外国新闻才有用。

tip: foreign 是形容词，不说 foreign country people，说 people from other countries 或 foreigners。

ex.en: We live on the earth.
ex.zh: 我们生活在地球上。

ex.en: Healthy earth near a river can hold flood water that concrete sends straight into the street.
ex.zh: 河边健康的土壤能蓄住洪水，而混凝土会把水直接送进街道。

tip: the earth 指地球时常加 the。on earth 也可加强疑问语气。

ex.en: The students organised the fair themselves.
ex.zh: 学生们自己组织了这次义卖。

ex.en: Communities can protect a river themselves, but they still need the law behind them.
ex.zh: 社区可以自己保护一条河，但他们仍然需要法律在背后支持。

tip: themselves 不能代替 they 作主语。

ex.en: There is little time before the bus leaves.
ex.zh: 汽车开走前时间不多了。

ex.en: A little shade on a playground can make summer sports safer for younger children.
ex.zh: 操场上一点点荫凉，就能让年幼的孩子在夏天运动时更安全。

tip: little 偏否定，表示几乎没有；a little 表示有一点。都修饰不可数名词。

ex.en: We read a European folk story.
ex.zh: 我们读了一个欧洲民间故事。

ex.en: European visitors bring money to a town, but they also raise rents if housing is already short.
ex.zh: 欧洲游客给城镇带来钱，但如果住房已经短缺，他们也会推高房租。

tip: European 和 Europe 都要大写。

senses.en: a piece of candy or a sweet dish

ex.en: This tea is too sweet for me.
ex.zh: 这茶对我来说太甜了。

ex.en: A sweet snack every afternoon can hide how much sugar a teenager drinks in a week.
ex.zh: 每天下午一块甜点，会掩盖青少年一周喝下多少糖。

tip: sweet 作名词时常指糖果，英式英语更常见。

ex.en: She felt a pain in her knee after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后她感到膝盖疼。

ex.en: Tooth pain that waits a month for a clinic becomes a larger problem than it was on the first day.
ex.zh: 等了一个月才看上诊所的牙痛，会比第一天更严重。

tip: pain 可数或不可数都可以。

senses.en: a long flat surface in a shop or bank

ex.en: Please pay at the counter.
ex.zh: 请在柜台付款。

ex.en: A counter that is too high hides the person who is serving a child.
ex.zh: 太高的柜台会挡住正在给孩子服务的那个人。

tip: counter 作动词是反驳。run counter to 表示与……相反。

senses.en: the early part of the day

ex.en: I review words every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨复习单词。

ex.en: A hot morning in a room without fans makes the first lesson harder than it needs to be.
ex.zh: 没有风扇的房间里炎热的早晨，会让第一节课难上加难。

tip: 泛指上午用 in the morning；具体某一天上午用 on Monday morning。

ex.en: The farm is two miles from school.
ex.zh: 农场离学校两英里。

ex.en: A mile of pavement matters more to a walking student than a faster road with none.
ex.zh: 对步行的学生来说，一英里人行道比没有人行道的更快的路更重要。

tip: 1 mile 约 1.6 公里。英里是 mile，米是 metre。

ex.en: Please wait outside the office.
ex.zh: 请在办公室外面等。

ex.en: Noise from outside a classroom can undo the quiet a teacher is trying to keep.
ex.zh: 教室外面的噪音可以毁掉老师试图保持的安静。

tip: outside 可作介词或副词。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not named

ex.en: I left my bag somewhere in the hall.
ex.zh: 我把包落在大厅的某个地方了。

ex.en: Students need somewhere quiet to read when home has no spare room.
ex.zh: 家里没有空房间时，学生需要一个安静的地方读书。

tip: somewhere 是副词，前面不加 in。表里这一行的音标是 sometimes，本库不用。

ex.en: Please tell the truth about the broken window.
ex.zh: 请说出打破窗户的真相。

ex.en: The truth about a flood includes which streets were under water, not only the official speech.
ex.zh: 洪水的真相包括哪些街被水淹了，而不只是官方的讲话。

tip: truth 通常不可数。

senses.en: the direction between north and west

ex.en: The wind is from the north-west.
ex.zh: 风从西北来。

ex.en: Villages in the north-west share one clinic, so the winter road between them must stay open.
ex.zh: 西北的村子共用一家诊所，所以它们之间的冬季道路必须保持通畅。

tip: north-west 也可写作 northwest。

ex.en: The black cat slept on the warm step.
ex.zh: 黑猫睡在温暖的台阶上。

ex.en: Black smoke from old buses is a daily health problem for students waiting at the stop.
ex.zh: 旧公交冒出的黑烟，是等车学生每天面对的健康问题。

tip: black 也可作名词表示黑色。

senses.en: a game, or the ball used in it

ex.en: Basketball practice is at four.
ex.zh: 篮球训练在四点。

ex.en: A basketball court that locks at dusk leaves the students who finish late outside.
ex.zh: 黄昏就锁上的篮球场，把下课晚的学生留在外面。

tip: 球类运动前通常不加 the：play basketball。

senses.en: the body that goes round the earth

ex.en: The moon was bright on the way home.
ex.zh: 回家的路上月亮很亮。

ex.en: A town that turns off some lights can still see the moon, and the owls can hunt.
ex.zh: 关掉一部分灯的城镇仍然看得见月亮，猫头鹰也能捕猎。

tip: moon 前通常加 the。

ex.en: The shop is closed on Christmas Day.
ex.zh: 商店在圣诞节关门。

ex.en: Christmas lights can make a street feel safe at night if they do not replace the ordinary lamps.
ex.zh: 圣诞灯可以让街道在夜里感觉安全，如果它们不是用来代替普通路灯的。

tip: Christmas 要大写。

ex.en: I have never seen such a clear night sky.
ex.zh: 我从没见过这么晴朗的夜空。

ex.en: Such a small tax on plastic bags can change what millions of shoppers carry home.
ex.zh: 对塑料袋征收如此小的一笔费用，就能改变数百万人拎回家的东西。

tip: such a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数；so + 形容词。

senses.en: to defeat, or to hit repeatedly

ex.en: Our team beat Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队打败了三班。

ex.en: You cannot beat a flood with a speech if the drains are still too small.
ex.zh: 如果排水管仍然太小，你无法用一篇讲话打败洪水。

tip: 打败某人用 beat sb；赢得比赛用 win a match。过去式是 beat，过去分词是 beaten。

senses.en: an act of performing, or how well someone does

ex.en: The music performance starts at seven.
ex.zh: 音乐表演七点开始。

ex.en: A student's performance on one test should not decide the whole story of a year.
ex.zh: 学生一次考试的表现，不该决定一整年的全部故事。

tip: performance 可指演出，也可指工作或学习表现。

senses.en: to give information to someone, or to recognise a difference

ex.en: Please tell me when the meeting starts.
ex.zh: 请告诉我会议什么时候开始。

ex.en: A label should tell shoppers where food comes from, not only how attractive the packet looks.
ex.zh: 标签应该告诉购物者食物来自哪里，而不只是包装有多好看。

col: tell sb to do｜叫某人做
tip: tell 后面接人：tell sb sth。say 后面接说的内容，不直接接人。

senses.en: the sound of speaking, or the right to speak

ex.en: She has a clear voice.
ex.zh: 她的声音很清楚。

ex.en: Students need a voice in decisions about the hour their school day starts.
ex.zh: 关于上学时间的决定，学生需要有发言权。

tip: voice 多指人的嗓音；sound 是任何声音。

senses.en: a series of lessons, or the way something develops

ex.en: I chose a history course this term.
ex.zh: 这学期我选了一门历史课。

ex.en: Of course a new course needs books, but it also needs a teacher who has time to mark them.
ex.zh: 新课程当然需要书，但也需要有时间批改的老师。

col: in the course of｜在……过程中
tip: course 表示课程；of course 是固定短语“当然”。

ex.en: The story is about a king who listened to farmers.
ex.zh: 故事讲的是一位倾听农民的国王。

ex.en: Even a king in an old tale needed roads and grain, which is still true of any government.
ex.zh: 即使是旧故事里的国王也需要道路和粮食，任何政府今天仍然如此。

tip: king 是可数名词。

senses.en: the ability to learn and understand

ex.en: The quiz does not measure all of a student's intelligence.
ex.zh: 这次小测测不出一名学生的全部智力。

ex.en: Artificial intelligence can sort answers, and a teacher still has to notice who is lost.
ex.zh: 人工智能可以给答案分类，老师仍然得注意到谁没跟上。

tip: intelligence 通常不可数。表示情报时多用于机构名称。

senses.en: low land between hills or mountains

ex.en: Fog stays in the valley in the morning.
ex.zh: 早晨雾留在山谷里。

ex.en: Schools in a valley share one road, so a flood closes more than one gate.
ex.zh: 山谷里的学校共用一条路，所以一场洪水会关上不止一扇校门。

tip: valley 可数。河流经过的谷地也叫 valley。

ex.en: She tried to convince him to stay.
ex.zh: 她试图说服他留下来。

ex.en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。

col: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事
convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

ex.en: We walked on the beach after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们在海滩上走了走。

ex.en: A popular beach can damage the coast if plastic from one weekend is left in the sand.
ex.zh: 如果一个周末的塑料留在沙子里，受欢迎的海滩会破坏海岸。

tip: beach 是可数名词。

ex.en: The temperature fell below zero last night.
ex.zh: 昨夜气温降到了零度以下。

ex.en: Scores below the pass line still show effort, and they should not be the only story of a term.
ex.zh: 低于及格线的分数仍然说明有努力，而且不该成为一学期的唯一故事。

tip: below 强调低于某个水平；under 多指在某物正下方。

senses.en: great respect, or something that brings it
to show respect, or to give an award

ex.en: It was an honor to speak for the class.
ex.zh: 代表班级发言是一种荣誉。

ex.en: An honor roll that lists only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
ex.zh: 只列分数的光荣榜，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。

tip: honor 是美式拼写，英式是 honour。作动词是尊敬或授予荣誉。

senses.en: a person's social or legal position

ex.en: The form asks for your student status.
ex.zh: 表格询问你的学生身份。

ex.en: Social status should not decide who may use the public library after school.
ex.zh: 社会地位不该决定谁可以在放学后使用公共图书馆。

tip: status 通常不可数。法律地位、社会地位都可以用。

ex.en: The school wants to reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 学校想减少食物浪费。

ex.en: Cities can reduce traffic near schools by changing the bell, not only by adding lanes.
ex.zh: 城市可以靠调整铃声来减少学校附近的车流，而不只是加车道。

tip: reduce 后接所减少的东西。表里的美式音标不完整，美式读音用 espeak-ng。

ex.en: His wife teaches at the primary school.
ex.zh: 他的妻子在小学教书。

ex.en: A wife who works nights still needs a safe bus home after the last shift.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妻子在最后一班结束后，仍然需要一趟安全的回家公交。

tip: wife 的复数是 wives。

senses.en: an idea of how something is

ex.en: The concept is easier with a picture.
ex.zh: 这个概念配上一张图就容易些。

ex.en: Students grasp a new concept faster when they can test it on a familiar problem.
ex.zh: 学生若能用熟悉的题目检验一个新概念，就会理解得更快。

tip: concept 比 idea 更偏学科里的概念。

senses.en: a bad habit or moral fault

ex.en: The essay argues that waste is a public vice.
ex.zh: 文章认为浪费是一种公共恶习。

ex.en: The vice principal, not the principal, meets the bus company on Mondays.
ex.zh: 周一和公交公司见面的是副校长，不是校长。

tip: vice 作名词是恶习。放在职称前表示“副”：vice principal。两种意思不要混在一个句子里让人猜。

senses.en: a feeling of wanting something good

ex.en: I hope to see you at the concert.
ex.zh: 我希望在音乐会上见到你。

ex.en: Families hope the new clinic will open before winter, when travel on icy roads is harder.
ex.zh: 家人希望新诊所在冬天前开业，因为结冰的路更难走。

col: in the hope of｜抱着……的希望
tip: hope 后接 to do 或 that 从句，不说 hope sb to do。

senses.en: a person or book that shows the way

ex.en: The guide stopped at the old gate.
ex.zh: 向导在老城门前停下。

ex.en: A guide for new students works better with a map than with a speech alone.
ex.zh: 给新生的指南配上一张地图，比只有一篇讲话更有用。

tip: guide 作动词是引导。

senses.en: a hard shiny material such as iron or gold

ex.en: The gate is made of metal.
ex.zh: 这扇门是金属做的。

ex.en: Sorting metal from kitchen waste makes recycling possible and keeps the rest cleaner.
ex.zh: 把金属从厨余里分出来，回收才可能进行，其余垃圾也更干净。

tip: metal 作材料时常不可数。a metal 可指某一种金属。

senses.en: to control a vehicle, or to force something forward

ex.en: My uncle drives to work.
ex.zh: 我叔叔开车上班。

ex.en: High rents drive workers out of the centre, and then the morning roads fill with cars.
ex.zh: 高房租把工人赶出市中心，然后早晨的路就挤满了汽车。

col: drive sb to｜开车送某人去
tip: drive 的过去式是 drove，过去分词是 driven。

senses.en: a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Workers demand better pay and safety.
ex.zh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和安全。

ex.en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
ex.zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: to deal with a difficult situation

ex.en: She had a smile on her face.
ex.zh: 她脸上带着微笑。

ex.en: A city must face the fact that cheap housing and clean air are both necessary.
ex.zh: 一座城市必须面对这个事实：廉价住房和干净空气都是必需的。

tip: face 作动词表示面对：face a problem，不要说 face to a problem。

ex.en: There is a bowl of rice on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有一碗米饭。

ex.en: A cracked bowl in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
ex.zh: 食堂里裂了的碗应当当天扔掉。

tip: bowl 可数。a bowl of 后接所盛的东西。

senses.en: to say something is true; to allow in
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: He had to admit that he was wrong.
ex.zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。

ex.en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
ex.zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

col: admit doing something｜承认做过某事
be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

ex.en: Our teacher returned the essays on Friday.
ex.zh: 老师周五发还了作文。

ex.en: A new teacher needs time to learn the names, and a class can help by sitting in the same places at first.
ex.zh: 新老师需要时间记名字，班级一开始坐在固定位置可以帮上忙。

tip: 说 a teacher of English，或 an English teacher。

senses.en: to give something that is needed

ex.en: The school provides lunch for students.
ex.zh: 学校为学生提供午餐。

ex.en: Cities should provide lights on the road home, not only seats in the classroom.
ex.zh: 城市应该在回家的路上提供照明，而不只是教室里的座位。

col: provide sb with sth｜向某人提供
provide sth for sb｜为某人提供
tip: provide 的两种搭配：provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for sb。

ex.en: The teacher will announce the exam date tomorrow.
ex.zh: 老师明天会宣布考试日期。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

senses.en: people living together under shared rules

ex.en: Schools are part of society, not separate from it.
ex.zh: 学校是社会的一部分，不是与之分开的。

ex.en: A society that measures success only by test scores will miss students who help their families after class.
ex.zh: 只用考分衡量成功的社会，会忽略那些课后帮助家人的学生。

tip: society 可数。the society 有时指某个社团。

ex.en: The road to the museum is closed today.
ex.zh: 去博物馆的路今天封闭。

ex.en: A wider road can invite more cars unless buses and bikes are given space too.
ex.zh: 更宽的路会招来更多汽车，除非公交和自行车也有空间。

tip: road 多指车辆道路；street 多指两边有建筑的街道。

ex.en: The ad on the board is for the book fair.
ex.zh: 布告栏上的广告是书展的。

ex.en: An ad aimed at teenagers should say who paid for it.
ex.zh: 面向青少年的广告应当说明是谁出的钱。

tip: ad 是 advertisement 的缩写。正式写作用全称。

senses.en: a large room for meetings or events

ex.en: The concert is in the school hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。

ex.en: A town hall that opens in the evening gives working parents a place to hear the budget.
ex.zh: 晚上开放的市政厅，给上班的家长一个听预算说明的地方。

tip: hall 可指礼堂、门厅或市政厅，要看搭配。

ex.en: The classroom was too hot to concentrate.
ex.zh: 教室热得无法集中注意力。

ex.en: Hot nights without fans make it harder for students to sleep before an exam.
ex.zh: 没有风扇的炎热夜晚，让学生更难在考试前入睡。

tip: hot 的比较级是 hotter。

senses.en: to choose, or to take fruit or flowers

ex.en: Pick a question you can explain.
ex.zh: 选一道你能解释的题。

ex.en: Families pick a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
ex.zh: 家庭会选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。

tip: pick up sb 可以表示开车接人。

ex.en: They discussed politics in the history club.
ex.zh: 他们在历史社里讨论政治。

ex.en: School politics is not only elections; it is also who gets to speak in a meeting.
ex.zh: 校园政治不只是选举，也包括谁能在会上发言。

tip: politics 作学科时谓语常用单数：Politics is interesting。

senses.en: of the colour of a clear sky

ex.en: She wore a blue coat.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件蓝色外套。

ex.en: Blue signs that nobody can read at night do not make a crossing safer.
ex.zh: 夜里没人看得清的蓝色标志，并不能让过街更安全。

tip: blue 也可作名词表示蓝色。

ex.en: The concert is tonight.
ex.zh: 音乐会在今晚。

ex.en: A storm warning for tonight helps only families who can still receive it.
ex.zh: 今晚的风暴警报只帮助仍能收到它的家庭。

tip: tonight 前面不加介词 on。

senses.en: help given to people, or a public system

ex.en: The bus service stops at ten.
ex.zh: 公交服务十点结束。

ex.en: A health service that only works in the city centre leaves villages waiting for basic care.
ex.zh: 只在市中心运转的医疗服务，会让乡村等待基本的照料。

tip: service 表示服务时常不可数；一项具体服务有时用 a service。

ex.en: I checked the bus times on the Internet.
ex.zh: 我在网上查了公交时刻。

ex.en: The Internet spreads a correction slowly if the false picture was more exciting.
ex.zh: 如果假图片更刺激，互联网传播更正就会很慢。

tip: Internet 常大写，前面加 the。

senses.en: a substance used in or produced by chemistry

ex.en: The chemical is labelled and locked.
ex.zh: 这种化学品贴了标签并锁好了。

ex.en: A school lab should name every chemical and still not publish a method for misuse.
ex.zh: 学校实验室应当标明每一种化学品，同时仍然不公布误用的方法。

tip: chemical 作形容词是化学的。本条不写配制或滥用方法。

senses.en: a set of different things, or the limits of something

ex.en: The shop sells a wide range of pens.
ex.zh: 这家店卖各种各样的笔。

ex.en: A wide range of bus times helps workers whose shifts do not match a school day.
ex.zh: 多样的公交班次有助于那些班次和上学日对不上的工人。

col: in the range of｜在……范围内
tip: range from A to B 表示范围从 A 到 B。

senses.en: to be unable to find, or to be beaten

ex.en: Do not lose your student card.
ex.zh: 别弄丢学生证。

ex.en: Towns lose young workers when housing, jobs, and buses are all somewhere else.
ex.zh: 当住房、工作和公交都在别处时，城镇会失去年轻工人。

tip: lose 的过去式和过去分词是 lost。

senses.en: a light in the night sky, or a famous performer

ex.en: We could see one bright star above the hill.
ex.zh: 我们能看见山上空一颗明亮的星。

ex.en: A film star visiting a school for one hour does less than a teacher who stays all year.
ex.zh: 在学校停留一小时的电影明星，不如全年留下来的老师做得更多。

tip: star 作动词是“主演”。

senses.en: a person who acts in plays or films

ex.en: The actor visited the drama club.
ex.zh: 这位演员来了戏剧社。

ex.en: An actor who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
ex.zh: 只念台词的演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。

tip: 现在 actor 也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

ex.en: There is a link between sleep and attention.
ex.zh: 睡眠和注意力之间有联系。

ex.en: The bus link between the village and the clinic is as important as the clinic itself.
ex.zh: 村子和诊所之间的公交联系，和诊所本身一样重要。

tip: link 作动词是“连接”。

ex.en: The story ends with the death of the old tree.
ex.zh: 故事以那棵老树的死亡结束。

ex.en: Heat-related death is more common in neighbourhoods with little shade and few clinics.
ex.zh: 与高温有关的死亡，在少荫凉、少诊所的社区更常见。

tip: death 是名词；die 是动词；dead 是形容词。
